name: MathModelAgent
description: 🤖📐专为数学建模设计的 Agent & skills ,自动完成数学建模，生成一份完整的可以直接提交的论文。 An Agent Designed for Mathematical Modeling ,Automatically complete mathmodel and generate a complete paper ready for submission.
one_liner: An AI assistant that takes a math-modeling competition problem and automatically writes the code, runs the analysis, and produces a finished, submission-ready paper.
buyer: A university student or small tutoring center preparing teams for mathematical modeling competitions (like MCM/ICM) who wants to cut days of paper-writing down to hours.
business_use_cases: A math-competition tutoring center offers a paid 'AI-assisted modeling bootcamp' where students learn using this tool to speed up practice rounds.
An academic services company sells a hosted version to student teams as exam-season 'writing assistant' access during major competition seasons.
A freelance tutor bundles access plus personal coaching as a premium package for teams entering MCM/ICM or China's national modeling contest.

money_ideas.idea: Sell seasonal access to a hosted version timed around major competition deadlines (already teased with an online version at mathmodel.top).
Offer paid template packs and coaching bundled with the tool for competition prep services.

steal_this: Package the hosted online version with a handful of competition-specific templates and sell timed access during MCM/ICM and national contest seasons.
